name: WWO World Championship
notes: Contested on the promotion's Wednesday Night War of 20 March 2002.
epitaph: Jimmy Rage was billed as champion when Ray Scott beat him for it on Wednesday Night War, 20 March 2002, and Scott kept it eleven days later in a Hell in the Cell match against Jim Masters at Easter Extravaganza. Two reigns on record.

name: WWO Intercontinental Championship
epitaph: Iron Face carried it into Easter Extravaganza on 31 March 2002 and lost it there to Mick Williams in a three-way that also included Joe. Two reigns on record.

name: WWO Lightweight Championship
notes: Billed on both surviving March 2002 cards.
epitaph: Billed on Mick Williams on 20 March 2002 and on Chris Callahan eleven days later, when Callahan kept it in a ladder match against John Harris; the record does not show how it changed hands. Two reigns on record.

name: WWO Hardcore Championship
notes: Billed on both surviving March 2002 cards.
epitaph: Rammstein was billed as holder on both surviving March 2002 cards and kept it against Steel Face in a hardcore match on 31 March. One reign on record.
